title: Myelin segmentation
summary: Learning to recover three-dimensional myelin structure from optical focal stacks.
question: What myelin structure can we recover from optical images, and where does the evidence run out?
abstract: This project explores learned segmentation and reconstruction of myelin from optical focal stacks. It brings together representation learning, weak supervision, and evaluation of three-dimensional material recovery.

The central challenge is to distinguish image-supported structure from plausible geometry. Material recovery, fiber continuity, and depth need separate evaluation; visual plausibility alone does not establish validated anatomy.
